verdict.rationale: Circle documents registrable webhooks: an HTTP POST goes to your configured endpoint when a resource changes state, and Gateway has webhook subscription management. CPN notifications are signed, with a public key endpoint for verification. However, the specific money-movement events the story names are not enumerated, and signing is documented only for CPN. missing for 10: documented event types for payment confirmed, payout settled and conversion executed; evidence that signing applies across all products; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, money movement emits signed webhooks — payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed — so my system tracks state without polling chains or dashboards

citations.quote: When a resource changes state, Circle sends an HTTP POST to the endpoint you configure so your application can react.
Manage webhook subscriptions for Gateway event notifications.
Verify each notification's signature before you trust it. Fetch the public key with `GET /v2/cpn/notifications/publicKey/{id}`.
